name: Guangdong Dongfang Precision Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Dongfang Precision Science & Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of corrugated packaging equipment in China and internationally.
